title: Model Block
description: Add 3D models (GLB/GLTF/VRM) to the environment with full transform controls and physics options.

threeobjecturl.description: URL to the 3D model file (GLB, GLTF, or VRM format)

rotationx.description: Rotation around X axis in DEGREES — this block converts degrees to radians at runtime, unlike most blocks which take radians directly

rotationy.description: Rotation around Y axis in DEGREES — this block converts degrees to radians at runtime, unlike most blocks which take radians directly

rotationz.description: Rotation around Z axis in DEGREES — this block converts degrees to radians at runtime, unlike most blocks which take radians directly

animations.description: Comma-separated list of animation names to play

instanced.description: Enable instanced rendering for multiple copies

instances.description: JSON array of instance transform data for instanced models

proximityload.description: Enable (1) to only load model when player is within trigger zone

triggerlocationx.description: Width of the proximity trigger zone (0 = disabled)

triggerlocationy.description: Height of the proximity trigger zone (0 = disabled)

triggerlocationz.description: Depth of the proximity trigger zone (0 = disabled)

triggerlocationposx.description: X offset of the trigger zone from model position

triggerlocationposy.description: Y offset of the trigger zone from model position

triggerlocationposz.description: Z offset of the trigger zone from model position
